definitions.full: H6216. ashoq עָשׁוֺק noun [masculine] oppressor, extortioner ; — Jer 22:3 (= עשֵׁק 21:12 ).

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.
